candidates.summary: validText refuses only letters of non-allowlisted scripts next to Latin, while the allowlist (Arabic, Hebrew, Devanagari...) holds Latin look-alikes; titleKey folds none of them, so a title one glyph away from a visible title is listed next to it
candidates.failure_scenario: Visible "Gnoland Swap". Each of "Gn\u09E6land Swap" (Bengali digit zero: Bengali is not on the allowlist, but a digit is not a letter so foreign stays false), "Gn\u0966land Swap" (Devanagari zero), "Gno\u0627and Swap" (Arabic alef for l), "Gn\u05E1land Swap" (Hebrew samekh for o) and "Gno\u05C0and Swap" (Hebrew paseq, the glyph of the ASCII '|' that titleKey folds to l) passes validText, gets a distinct titleKey and is registered. ADR T6 says Latin is refused next to letters of any script outside an allowlist that does not mimic Latin, and titleKey's comment says it covers what validText cannot refuse

candidates.summary: commonLatin admits every Latin Extended-B letter below U+0250 except the four click letters, including LATIN CAPITAL LETTER IOTA (U+0196, an l) and WYNN (U+01BF, a p); titleKey folds neither, so a pure-Latin copy of a title lists beside it

candidates.verify_by: gno test -v -run TestB8LatinExtBLookalikes with the same artifact: expect title_taken or bad_title, observe both listed

candidates.summary: a GovDAO pick is bound to the title alone: the app swaps its tagline at once, and its cover a day later, and keeps the "Picked by GovDAO" hero for the rest of the up-to-30-day pick
candidates.failure_scenario: GovDAO executes ProposeSpotlight("bee-hero", 7). The app's realm then calls Register with the same title and tagline "Official GovDAO airdrop, claim yours now": update() changes Tagline with no dropPick, picked() checks only shownApp and titleKey, and the home renders the new tagline under "## Picked by GovDAO". SubmitRich with a new cover shows after richDelay with picked() still true. ADR §3 says the pick is for the app as it was voted on
